```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)

url = "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster"

webpage = rvest::read_html(url)

# Select all person cards
people = webpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("#listPanel .s-person-card")

# Extract names
names = people |>
  rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__personal h3") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

# Extract hometowns
locations = people |>
  rvest::html_element(
    ".s-person-card__content__person__location-item"
  ) |>
  rvest::html_text2()

# Create the data frame
swim_df = data.frame(
  name = names,
  location = locations
)

# Exclude coaches (whose location is missing)
swim_df = swim_df |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(name),
    name != "",
    !is.na(location),
    location != ""
  )

```


```{r}
library(readr)
library(httr2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Read the CSV file
toxic_ips = readr::read_csv("toxic_ips_oct2025 (1).csv")

# 2. Extract the IP addresses
ip_addresses = toxic_ips$IP

# 3. Define the 17 required fields
fields = c(
  "status", "continent", "country", "countryCode",
  "region", "regionName", "city", "district",
  "zip", "lat", "lon", "timezone", "currency",
  "isp", "org", "as", "query"
)

# 4. Initialize the output data frame
ip_df = data.frame()

# 5. Loop through each IP address
for (ip in ip_addresses) {

  api_url = paste0("http://ip-api.com/json/", ip)

  # Send API request
  response = httr2::request(api_url) |>
    httr2::req_url_query(fields = paste(fields, collapse = ",")) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  # Convert JSON response to an R list
  ip_data = httr2::resp_body_json(response)

  # Create one row, keeping missing fields as NA
  row = lapply(fields, function(field) {
    value = ip_data[[field]]

    if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0) {
      return(NA)
    }

    value
  })

  names(row) = fields

  df = as.data.frame(row, check.names = FALSE)

  # Append the row
  ip_df = dplyr::bind_rows(ip_df, df)

  # Respect API rate limits
  remaining = as.integer(
    httr2::resp_header(response, "X-Rl")
  )

  if (!is.na(remaining) && remaining == 0) {
    wait = as.numeric(
      httr2::resp_header(response, "X-Ttl")
    )
    if (!is.na(wait)) Sys.sleep(wait + 1)
  }
}

# 6. Verify results
dim(ip_df)
names(ip_df)
print(ip_df)

stopifnot(
  nrow(ip_df) == 10,
  ncol(ip_df) == 17,
  identical(names(ip_df), fields),
  identical(as.character(ip_df$query), ip_addresses),
  all(ip_df$status == "success")
)
```
